name: setkernel-live
description: live.setkernel.com: what setkernel's AI engineers are doing, about a minute behind

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js public/*.js public/lib/*.js public/usage/*.js scripts/*.mjs workers/meter/src/*.js workers/meter/tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:worker && npm run test:meter && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config workers/meter/wrangler.toml --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-meter
